title: Prime Access Trailer/Khora
kind: 場所・ミッション・その他

lines: - "None of them truly understands how much I lost, when I lost her. Nor by what subtle art my dead love now lives, within another's gleaming skull.
So tonight, we shall celebrate. In her honor, and mine, I shall unveil a new creation, a harmony of mistress... and monster.
An apex predator, a deathless companion. Unsurpassed. Blood-raw in whip, claw and fang. Khora."
- The music for the Khora Prime trailer was composed by Evan Duffy. Featured vocals by Aeralie Brighton.
